problema: Overcome the sequential bottleneck where N tokens require N forward passes in AR models
patron: A decoding procedure that can propose multiple output positions at once and refine them iteratively, starting from maximum uncertainty
limite: Early diffusion models had lower quality than AR; quality improves with more steps

problema: Simplify training by eliminating gradient computation on already-determined tokens
patron: An identity-like operator that propagates known values unchanged while only computing predictions for unknowns
limite: Requires architectural support for copying; does not improve quality directly

problema: Reduce per-step computation cost in sequential generation
patron: Memoization of attention subcomputations based on the assumption that past activations do not change
limite: Only compatible with causal attention; activations must be immutable to cache safely

concepto: Tipo de mecanismo de atención (Attention mechanism type)
problema: Trade off global context awareness against computability of KV cache
patron: A masking operation on pairwise attention scores that enforces which positions can communicate, creating temporal or structural constraints
limite: Causal prevents true parallel generation; bidirectional prevents activation caching

problema: Enable KV caching in parallel diffusion models by converting bidirectional dependencies into causal form
patron: Permute input to create artificial causality where known values precede unknowns, enabling cached computation without losing global modeling
limite: Requires dynamic permutation each step; changes effective position embeddings

problema: Determine the fraction of masked tokens to reveal per denoising step
patron: Rate-of-change weighting that normalizes signal change by current noise level, adapting reveal rate to corruption state
limite: Must have α_s > α_t; depends on schedule and timestep selection

problema: Quantitatively measure language model quality and compare models on same benchmark
patron: A scalar summary statistic derived from negative log-likelihood that concentrates on common errors
limite: Correlates with downstream performance but metric depends on data distribution; not directly comparable across datasets
